label: lassie V4.1 fs3 layout (attention block, KV, shared experts, router, hc, norms, head on the GTX 1080 Ti; DSpark draft on the CPU; routed experts rows:0..7 + GROUPS=8, --no-mmap, T64 -cr 0-63, MAIN_NO_MOE, -ub 512) on 16/16 DIMMs, binary unpublished build with LLAMA_FA_DEC=1: decode (1 row) and draft-verify (<=5 dense / <=8 sparse rows) attention on the 1080 Ti through the new split-K kernel fattn_dec_sinks; prefill attention as fs3hyb; std + long, N=300

numa.src: routed experts rows:0..7 + GGML_MOE_GROUPS=8 (MAIN_NO_MOE: thread 0 issues CUDA); every dense rule of q8-dense-rows8 skips (those tensors sit on the GPU)
numa.verify: LLAMA_EXPERT_PLACEMENT_VERIFY=1 + numa_maps per node after load

src: run-lv41.sh arm fs3dec, B=build-fa-unpublished-sm61 (unpublished build) UB=512 N=300 SETS='std long' XENV='LLAMA_FA_TILE_NEW_SINKS=1 LLAMA_FA_TILE_NEW_SINKS_MIN_Q=2 LLAMA_FA_DEC=1'

conditions.kv_type: f16 (ik default), KV on the GPU; the V4 D=512 FA runs on the CPU on sm_61 (fattn tile_new unsupported)
conditions.draft_n: DSpark q2 draft (1017) weights on the CPU (-ngld 0); per request n4 (n_max 4, conf_cum_min 0.5) and n0

workload.prompt_kind: coding-agent.json first 3 briefs (std); per prompt n4 first (carries the prefill), then n0 with cache_prompt true

conditions.cpu_reserve: 64 SMT siblings left to the system
conditions.ram: dimm 16/16 (1073.6 GB, all 16 DDR4 channels; reseated 10-21 ~19:10Z, boot 19:14Z)
conditions.tmpfs_store: /mnt/v41 tmpfs mpol interleave 0-7 (all 8 nodes; the 15/16 fs3 ran 0-3,5-7)
conditions.binary: ik fa-dec unpublished build (unpublished build + fattn-dec-sinks: Pascal split-K decode attention, head size 512, sinks, K==V, src[5] row gather), incremental rebuild on lassie of build-fa-unpublished-sm61, llama-server sha256 722619dcf5da
co_tenants: fab mc-u1 fixture minidregg-client-consent pid 631782 (a deliberate 16 h store-growth profile run) ~75 % CPU on CPU 123, the SMT sibling of pinned thread CPU 59 (node 7); left alone; CPU 59 stayed in -cr 0-63 because dropping it breaks the 8 threads x 8 nodes MoE group symmetry
minidregg-client pid 468785 ~42-50 % CPU on CPU 5 (inside -cr 0-63, node 0); minidregg-host bursts to ~900 %; libvirtd ~42 %; pid 481491 ~16 % on CPU 71
homelab-embed (5 GiB on the 1080 Ti) stopped for the arm and restarted after it by run-lv41.sh
vm.zone_reclaim_mode 1 (set for these arms; host default 0, restored after)
tmpfs store /mnt/v41 reused as rebalanced (34.8 GiB per node resident in the server)
conditions.draft: DSpark q2 draft weights on the CPU (-ngld 0); phases n4 then n0 (n0 = draft off)

gate_waiver: vram_peak: the planner rejects any V4.1 GPU layout on the 1080 Ti (non-expert weights + KV do not fit, UNMODELLED). Measured 21:11Z on this package (dbg-gpu2.sh gpuattn, -ub 512): CUDA0 weights 8.33 GiB + KV 0.31 + compute 0.27 = 9.3 GiB of 11; -ub 2048 adds ~0.8 GiB compute (rows8ga: 1.09 vs 0.27 GiB), the draft dense ~0.65 GiB: ~10.8 of 11 GiB expected, OOM at load is the stated risk
gate_note: gate captured at launch (22:13Z); fs1 minus the draft dense on the GPU, so the DFlash K/V (720 MiB) fits
